body.name: \widehat\pi_n^{\mathrm{SK}}
body.def: The response-type probability vector obtained by applying equations (8)--(11) of Shingaki--Kuroki (2023) to the empirical no-selection table \(\widehat p_n\), in their label order \((00,01,10,11)\).
body.role: published experimental-proxy plug-in estimator used in the comparator reduction
